source.content: public class LocalIterable implements Iterable<String> { public Iterator<String> iterator() { return new List<String>{'first', 'second'}.iterator(); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeIterableIteratorContractsTest { @isTest static void iteratorContractWorks() { Iterable<String> values = new LocalIterable(); Iterator<String> it = values.iterator(); System.assert(it.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('first', it.next()); System.assert(it.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('second', it.next()); System.assert(!it.hasNext()); } }
